purpose: Map ESPN team abbreviations to WNBA_OFFICIAL (stats.wnba.com) team abbreviations for 2017-2025. Derived empirically from the staged bytes, then validated by score reconciliation — not assumed.
validation: With this crosswalk, 2085 of 2091 ESPN games (99.71%) match an official game on date + both team codes + both scores, with ZERO score disagreements among matched games. Without it: 0.00%. With the partial first-pass map only: 82.82%.

PHOENIX.rule: seasons <= 2024: ESPN 'PHX' -> official 'PHO'. seasons >= 2025: ESPN 'PHO' -> official 'PHX'.
PHOENIX.hazard: A fixed map is correct for 2017-2024 and silently WRONG for 2025. It fails SILENTLY — the join succeeds against the wrong team and stays internally self-consistent. This is the orientation-flip failure mode recorded in this repository on 2026-08-08, where three of eleven ingested winners were reversed and arithmetic checks could not detect it.
PHOENIX.required_guard: after joining, assert each team's season win-loss record reconciles independently against BOTH feeds. A crosswalk that produces a coherent but wrong join is worse than one that errors.

exhibition_and_non_franchise_codes.reason: All-Star and exhibition rosters (Team Wilson, Team Delle Donne, Team Stewart, Team Parker, Team Clark, Team Collier, USA national team). Not franchises. They must never enter a ratings model or a residual bank.
exhibition_and_non_franchise_codes.handling: EXCLUDED at join time, not deleted. The staged source bytes still contain every row.

unresolved_after_crosswalk.disposition: These stay PROVISIONAL under the official-plus-one finality rule. Do NOT force-match them. They are a coverage difference between two feeds, not a defect in either, and resolving them requires a direct wnba.com check.

2026_expansion_note: Portland: ESPN POR -> official PDX (found when MIN@PDX came back DATA_BLOCKED; the mapping recovered 27 reconciled games). ESPN 2026 also carries COOP and SPO codes — special-event squads, excluded by official-plus-one automatically.
